name: Pediatric OPD Triage Form
description: Captures triage of children attending the pediatric outpatient department, recording vital signs, anthropometry, clinical assessment, triage level, basic information and referral details to set the order in which they are seen.

questions.label: Pulse not palpable
questions.questionInfo: If checked Yes, the pulse rate box is hidden.
